in_sanskrit.name: Bitupan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of Cows
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Bitupan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Bitupan is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Bitu’ meaning cow and ‘Pan’ meaning lord. In Hindu mythology, Bitupan is considered as the lord of cows, who are revered as a symbol of prosperity and abundance.
